notes.title: Numerical value adjustments in patch 1.0.11.4
notes.content:
At first, we want to make a system like “everything is equal”, which means that the values of defence, attack and damage are equal to make the calculate of these statistics.

But actually, this setting has a bug that players can put all the resources into damage, then use skills to avoid the damage taken from enemies.

Obviously, compares to take damage directly, to avoid the damage is much more effective.

So the enemies need to do enough damage during few attack chances.

So this time, we reduce the upper limit of players’ damage, and increase the upper limit of defence value, at the same time, we also reduce the upper limit of enemies’ damage, it will make the game more interesting.

This adjustment will make parts of players unsatisfied (especially those players who has already put all resources on damage), but unlike those online games, we cannot give compensation to our players, maybe we can give you some medals or something else in the future.

During the EA test, our purpose is to adjust the value the the balance of the game, we want to make this game better and better, even the sequel of this game.

PS: If you want to make a negative comment, please calm down for 10 minutes, and watch the words before, if you still wanna make a negative comment, just do it.

notes.title: Version update - 6th March
notes.content:
Something went wrong today, here's the explanation.
The game has some hot update mechanisms, and there were no problems in previous tests, but today it was used on Steam for the first time, and we found out some things the first time, and then we quickly updated the full version.
After the update, it was found that some players still have file verification issues. After our investigation, we found that the incremental update of Steam will miss specific Unity project files (Streaming Assets). I can't determine whether it is our case or is universal. Or Steam's own file verification will restore the changed files back?
This has led to a concentration of bad reviews by players during a certain period of time. Up to now, there have been about 5 bad reviews due to this bug.
At present, we have completely blocked the hot update function and transferred the files (no longer storing Streaming Assets), which should be safe in theory.
In this regard, I apologize to all players who have encountered this bug. Now everything should be normal after updating the game (If there are still problems, please join our discord, we will answer your questions as soon as possible)
